findings.description: [Band 3 light mode — 09-stack-light-desktop.png, 11-stack-light-mobile.png, FRAMEWORKS & RUNTIMES, React icon] The React icon renders with an opaque solid black fill inside/behind its cyan ellipses on the light-gray rounded chip, turning it into a harsh black-and-cyan blotch (in dark mode 08/10 the dark center blends into the dark chip, hiding the defect). Fix: remove the dark interior fill path or swap to a clean transparent-background cyan/teal stroke-only React mark for light mode so it sits cleanly on the light tile.

[Band 2 desktop — 04-activity-map-dark-desktop.png, 05-activity-map-light-desktop.png, REPO OUTPUT rows 3–5] Because FlashBeat (2.1k) is much larger than project-init (320), dotfiles (269), and atcoder-kit (149), rows 3–5 leave a ~400–450px empty horizontal gulf between each short bar and its far-right commit/PR counts, making horizontal row-tracking error-prone (mobile 06/07 avoids this by placing counts on the repo-name line above the bar). Fix: add whisper-quiet horizontal row hairlines (~4–6% opacity) or faint dotted leaders between bar ends and commit counts, or slightly narrow the bar column so counts sit closer.

[Band 1 desktop — 00-identity-dark-desktop.png, 01-identity-light-desktop.png, top-right Discord presence cluster] Prior v11 #2 improved substantially (from ~85px down to ~30px, and the icon gap is fixed), but '[Clyde] Offline · last synced Nov 24 · 22:46 JST' still ends ~28–35px shy of the right margin set by the horizontal dividers and Top Languages bar. Stacked directly above Band 2's laser-aligned right margin, this gap stands out. Fix: right-anchor the text run at the exact right margin (text-anchor='end') with a calibrated Clyde glyph offset, or shift the left-anchored start x ~30px right using tighter character-width metrics so 'JST' lands flush with the rule edge.

[Band 2 desktop & mobile — 04–07, top header stack GITHUB ACTIVITY / REPO OUTPUT] Prior v11 #5b remains unresolved: 'GITHUB ACTIVITY' + 'last 30 days · observed Nov 24 · 09:00 JST' sits directly above 'REPO OUTPUT' + 'bar = commits · max = 2.1k' with no separating hairline, creating two stacked uppercase+right-metadata header bars while peer subsection 'RECENT PUBLIC EVENTS' gets a crisp divider. Fix: add a hairline divider under 'GITHUB ACTIVITY' to frame both subsections symmetrically, or drop the redundant 'REPO OUTPUT' heading and fold the bar legend cleanly beneath a single band header.

[Band 2 desktop — 04-activity-map-dark-desktop.png, 05-activity-map-light-desktop.png, REPO OUTPUT summary lines] 'Other public (25)', 'Private repos', and 'Total' switch from the right-aligned monospace columns above to left-packed proportional inline text ('Other public (25) — 503 commits · 277 PRs'), breaking tabular column scanning and leaving the bottom-right half of the chart blank. Fix: align the commit and PR values for 'Other public' and 'Private repos' under the right-hand monospace columns (without bars, keeping the encoding honest) and separate 'Total' with a faint hairline, or add a subtle rule above the three summary lines to clearly mark the footer transition.

[Band 1 desktop & mobile — 00–03, TOP LANGUAGES legend row] The horizontal gap after 'TypeScript 44.7%' (~35–40px desktop, ~28px mobile) is visibly wider than the gaps after 'C# 39.9%' and 'C++ 7.7%' (~20–24px desktop, ~16px mobile), giving the legend an uneven rhythm from overestimated proportional text width. Fix: refine proportional width estimation for narrow letters so spacing between all four legend items is uniform.

[Band 3 mobile — 10-stack-dark-mobile.png, 11-stack-light-mobile.png, top header] 'TECHNOLOGY STACK' sits tighter to the top edge (~10px) and to 'DESIGN & MOTION' (~10px) than 'GITHUB ACTIVITY' does in Band 2 (~20px top margin), slightly compressing Band 3's entrance on mobile. Fix: match Band 2's ~18–20px top padding and add +4px between 'TECHNOLOGY STACK' and 'DESIGN & MOTION'.

[Cross-band verification & holistic assessment] All v9 and v10 findings are resolved; from v11, Band 1 desktop metaGrid grouping/right reach (#1), Band 2 desktop bottom slab (#3), Band 1 mobile meta-row breathing room (#4), and the '30 in 72h · Nov 24 JST' phrasing order (#5a) are all verified resolved. Overall design quality is high: clear designer-developer identity, honest Discord presence and observation timestamps, authentic GitHub-native language bar and activity feed without boxed dashboard cards, strong cross-band typographic coherence, and lean, legible 400px mobile layouts. Top 3 ranked changes: (1) fix the light-mode React icon black-fill bug in Band 3, (2) add subtle row-tracking guides to Band 2 desktop REPO OUTPUT, (3) flush-align Band 1 desktop's Discord cluster to the right margin and add a divider/simplify the Band 2 double header.

verdict.summary: APPROVE WITH FIXES (request-changes): v12 reads like a genuinely designed, personal, editorial GitHub profile rather than a boxed stats dashboard — strong first-glance comprehension, honest Discord offline presence and timestamps, coherent cross-band typography, clean visual hierarchy (putting Design & Motion first and scaling Infra chips down to 28px), and compact, legible 400px mobile layouts. All v9/v10 issues and most v11 issues (metaGrid grouping, Band 2 bottom slab, mobile meta breathing room, event header ordering) are resolved. However, one major light-mode rendering defect (React icon shows a solid black blotch inside its cyan orbits on light tiles in 09/11) plus minor layout polish (Band 2 desktop bar-to-number scanning gap, Band 1 desktop Discord cluster ~30px short of the right margin, Band 2 GITHUB ACTIVITY/REPO OUTPUT double-header lacking a divider, Band 1 uneven language legend gaps) should be fixed before shipping. Top 3 changes: (1) fix the light-mode React icon in Band 3, (2) add subtle row guides in Band 2 desktop REPO OUTPUT, (3) flush-align Band 1 desktop Discord status to the right margin and clean up Band 2's double header.
